_about: Our own corrections to ETH's data, so places read the way students know them, in English. Used by the Worker (worker/overrides.ts) and the scripts in scripts/. Each entry may have a 'why'; it is not shown anywhere.

spaces._about: Study spaces and mensas, keyed by ETH's roomGlobalIdentifier (e.g. 'HGE30.7'). Fields: name (shown instead of ETH's description, which is German even in ETH's English feed), category ('library', 'open' or 'mensa'; 'open' moves a mensa into the study spaces list), merge_into (another space's id: this one is shown as part of that one, its seats and features added). Proper names (Grüner Boden, Clausiusbar, Mensa Polyterrasse, Tannenstrasse, ...) are kept as ETH has them; a space without a name here shows ETH's.

HGE30.7.name: HG Lobby
HGE30.7.why: ETH calls it 'Catering'; students study there all day

HGF30.1.why: Students use the Rondell as a study space

CLAD1.1.why: Both Clausiusbar rooms are practically one area, serving food and open for studying at the same times

eateries._about: Places with menus in ETH's gastronomy system (Cookpit), keyed by Cookpit's facility id. Fields: kind ('mensa': has a menu, shown with a Menu button; 'cafe': everything else, listed and mapped as a cafeteria), space (a study space's id: that space's card is this place; while ETH's live list doesn't have the space, the place is a card of its own with the space's id, as below), else the place is a card of its own with name, building, floor (all three default to Cookpit's facility record) and area ('Z' or 'H', required; also given for a space, for that case); hidden (true leaves the place out; say why in CHOICES.md); cafe_outside_meals (true: a mensa only in its meal times, a cafeteria the rest of the day); merge_into (another facility's id: shown as part of that place); flagship (a mensa's signature line, as Cookpit names it: the Eat tab's card shows that line's dish of the current or next meal, else the meal's most expensive dish; Raffaele named Street, Wok Street and The Expert, the rest are the line with the highest student price in the week of 9 November 2026). Every building must already be a building chip or on the map (scripts/make_map.py reads this section too).

3.why: Clausiusbar; CLAD1.1 is merged into it

5.why: Dozentenfoyer, HG: publishes a lunch menu

11.why: Tannenbar, ML: a mensa all day (CHOICES.md)

22.why: Rice Up!, HIT; one rota for the whole year

4.why: Kiosk CLA is part of Clausiusbar

23.why: Octavo, OCT: not on our map (CHOICES.md)

mensa_order._about: Each location's mensas in our order, by place id (a study space's id, F<Cookpit facility> or UZH's UM<n>), used where no position is known: the Eat list (open ones first, then the closed ones in the same order; places not listed after, by name), the comparison's chips (its default pick is the first two, or your stars), and the map's mensa labels (the first wins a collision). UZ uses Z's list (both are compared and listed together). Raffaele's order, 15 November 2026.

extra_spaces._about: Study spaces ETH's list doesn't have, added by us (worker/spaces.ts parseSpaces appends them), keyed by our id. Fields: name, room (the line under the name), building (its own building code, drawn by scripts/make_map.py: an OSM outline from data/map/campuses.json `buildings`, or cut out of another's with `carve`), area ('Z' or 'H'), also_in (other locations that list it too), category ('workspace': the Study tab's Workspaces), seats (null: not known), hours (for the open state, in ETH's form 'Mon - Sun: 00.00 - 23.59'), shown_hours (the opening-hours lines the view shows instead), open_text (the status while open, instead of 'Open'), notice (a line under the status), info_url (left out: no Official info button), map (false: not drawn, the building is on no campus map).

FABRIK.name: Fabrik

IPZH.name: IPZ Hangar
IPZH.notice: In Dübendorf, not on the map yet.
IPZH.why: ETH's hangar at the Innovationspark Zürich in Dübendorf, outside every campus: listed in both ETH locations, not drawn (map: false, scripts/make_map.py leaves it out). Raffaele, 20 November 2026

buildings._about: Buildings, keyed by ETH's building code (e.g. 'MM'). Fields: label (shown on the map instead of the code), place (a study space or place id: that mensa has no label of its own on the map, the building's label shows its state).

MM.label: Poly
MM.why: Students know the Mensa Polyterrasse building as the Poly; its label is the mensa's on the map

room_types._about: Room types, keyed by ETH's typecode. Fields: name (shown instead of ETH's German type name). ETH's room-info API has English names too (lang=en), but they read awkwardly ('Seminars / Courses', 'Draw'), so we keep fetching German and name the types ourselves.

rooms._about: ETH rooms, keyed by their path as frooms shows it (e.g. 'HG G 19.1'). Fields: managed_by (a department that also books the room in a system of its own, which ETH's room info doesn't have: ETH's bookings still count, but where ETH lists none the room isn't free but 'D-MATH managed', orange on the bar). ETH's room page has no allocation link for such rooms.
